summary: This dataset involves the development of a novel ultrasound imaging technique for visualizing blood flow in the optic nerve head (ONH) and retrobulbar circulation, which are key areas affected in glaucoma. The technique utilizes high-frequency ultrasonic 2D arrays and a fully configurable ultrasound imaging system to provide high-resolution microvessel blood flow imaging. The dataset aims to fabricate and integrate the 2D array, implement 3D plane-wave imaging, and develop a 3D super-resolution ultrasound microvessel imaging algorithm using flow phantoms and in vivo rabbit eye imaging.
